item.title: X Briefing — Oct 27, 2026
item.description: Good morning, Angel. It's Tuesday, October twenty-seventh, and this is your X briefing. Today there's a fourth voice in the room. Peter B joins Mike Cernovich, Adam Townsend and BowTiedBull. Grab the coffee. Here's the headline. Monday was the day AI came for the office job, at least on paper. Anthropic filed to go public, and Microsoft offered buyouts to about sixty thousand employees. All four…
